# Pritam Bag - Portfolio

> Software Development Engineer based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.
> Builds backend systems, data pipelines, and web and mobile apps on top of them.
> 2+ years building production software at Rxefy Tech and Iquester Solutions LLP.

## About

Pritam Bag is a software engineer working across Python/FastAPI and Laravel backends,
data pipelines, Next.js and React Native apps, and Dolibarr/WooCommerce integrations. He holds an MCA
from Techno India Hooghly (CGPA 8.71) and a B.Sc in Mathematics from Barasat College (CGPA 9.10).

Currently at Iquester Solutions LLP (since March 2026) as primary developer on WIIMO, a product-data platform for Indian packaged foods with 8,300+ products and 31,000+ images, which he owns from scraping to deployment.

## Skills

- Languages: Python, PHP, JavaScript
- Back-End: FastAPI, Laravel, REST APIs, async processing, job queues, multi-tenant design
- Front-End: React, Next.js, React Native, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS
- Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLAlchemy, Alembic
- DevOps / Tools: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Caddy, Git, DigitalOcean, Playwright

## Notable Work

- Lead engineer on WIIMO (https://wiimo.in/), a packaged-food platform on web and Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.wiimo.app) that shows ingredients, additives, nutrition and an A-E health grade; built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js and Expo/React Native
- Scraped quick-commerce listings with Playwright into PostgreSQL: 8,300+ products and 31,000+ images, with OCR tagging for ingredients and nutrition
- Built a token-authenticated ingestion and review pipeline with 2FA-protected approvals and automated completeness scoring
- Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions (signed APK, release, SSH deploy) and Docker Compose behind Caddy
- Built an async Python scraper with Gemini-based classification that qualifies D2C brands at about 0.25 INR per site
- Built an event-driven, DB-backed Laravel queue with self-terminating workers (no persistent daemons)
- Built 5+ reusable Laravel packages including iquesters/user-management (published on Packagist)
- Built Dolibarr modules: a sales-order dashboard and a two-way WooCommerce order sync
- Published IQ Jobs Manager on WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/plugins/iq-jobs-manager/
- Contributed UI components to Wrappid, an in-house React framework

## Blog

- "Scraper Blocked by Cloudflare? We Built a Contribution Pipeline" - why a web scraper that worked locally was blocked by Cloudflare in production, and how WIIMO replaced it with a human-reviewed contribution pipeline: https://pritambag.in/blog/scraper-blocked-by-cloudflare-contribution-pipeline
- "Your Laravel App Keeps Growing Columns. WordPress Solved This 15 Years Ago." - architecture post on the Entity-Meta database pattern, pivot tables, and vertical scaling: https://pritambag.in/blog/entity-meta-pattern-laravel
- "What Custom Dolibarr Work Teaches About Business Software" - lessons from ERP templates, modules, deployment work, and client-specific customization: https://pritambag.in/blog/custom-dolibarr-business-software
